note: Whatever the sky is doing, stepping outside for five minutes to feel the air on your face can reset a stuck afternoon.

word.fact: “Radar” began as an acronym for “radio detection and ranging”, coined by the US Navy in 1940. It reads the same backwards, too.

hue.name: Storm cloud
hue.note: Storm clouds look dark because they are so tall and full of droplets that little sunlight makes it through to their base.
